reason: A local document-generation plugin that converts semantic JSON deck definitions into editable PPTX presentations, with validation, themes, previews, and agent-oriented CLI integration.

summaries.zh: 将语义化 JSON 演示文稿定义转换为可编辑 PPTX 文件，并提供验证、主题、预览和智能体 CLI 工作流。
summaries.en: Converts semantic JSON presentation definitions into editable PPTX files with validation, themes, previews, and agent-oriented CLI workflows.

capabilities: Generates editable PPTX presentations from JSON deck definitions
Validates slide structure and layout constraints
Renders SVG and HTML previews for review
Integrates with agent skill folders and CLI workflows
Writes generated presentation and preview files locally
